title: Floral Print Jacquard Cap Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at any wedding with this elegant floral print jacquard dress! Featuring charming cap sleeves, a flattering fit-and-flare silhouette, and intricate jacquard detailing, this dress is perfect for celebrating love in style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises jacquard.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
